messages:
lee_cs: Verdant Spark (trial) hit us with a demo request — need region-specific QPS bump and IP elevation for next 3 hours. They're worried about latency in eu-west-1 and want to run a live demo for the finance team. Renewal health: at-risk without this demo. Can infra open a temporary rule?

sam_infra: Can do. Need list of source IPs and exact qps target. Also verifying capacity in eu-west-1 for the window.

lee_cs: Thanks. Bookmarking details:
- demo window: 2026-09-03 14:00-17:00 UTC
- regions: eu-west-1 only
- qps target: 2200 (from baseline 400)
- IPs: 34.85.103.12, 34.85.103.13 (VPN egress)
- persistence: auto-revoke at 17:15 UTC

nina_pm: We'll join the demo for enablement. Jordan — can you prep a lightweight failover plan and a fallback model (smaller) in case of capacity spike?

jordan_se: Yep — I'll pin a smaller quantized variant and add an automatic fallback route by policy. Adding the short curl to test token is below:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TEST" -d '{"model":"vicuna-13b","input":"hello"}'
```

ops-bot: Autoscaling policy check: eu-west-1 has spare GPU capacity; temp reserved pool can accommodate +2k qps for 3 hours. Action needed: infra approval and customer IP CIDR add.

sam_infra: Approved by infra. I'll deploy the IP allow rules and the temporary rate window. Doing now, will post back when live. :white_check_mark:

micah_ce: FYI I'm prepping the renewal playbook note and post-demo health checklist. Will capture customer feedback in Gainsight.

sam_infra: Done — rules applied. Config snippet:

```
{ "customer": "verdant-spark", "region": "eu-west-1", "qps": 2200, "ips": ["34.85.103.12","34.85.103.13"], "expires_at": "2026-09-03T17:15:00Z" }
```

sam_infra: Load test pass at 2.2k qps for 20m, latency within SLOs. :thumbsup:

lee_cs: Amazing, thanks everyone. I'll coordinate the enablement runbook and join call at 13:45 UTC. micah_ce please push renewal note and follow up with demo outcome.

micah_ce: Will do — logging the follow-up action: collect demo transcript, SLO metrics, and Net Promoter from pilot attendees. tagging @renewals to flag potential at-risk uplift. :memo:

ops-bot: Auto-revoke scheduled at 2026-09-03T17:15:00Z unless extended.

lee_cs: Closing loop when demo completes.
